{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    tokens = case['tokens'][:]
    calls = case['calls']
    # Sort candidates: descending score, then start, then call_id
    sorted_calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (-c['score'], c['start'], c['call_id']))
    selected = []
    intervals = []  # list of (start, end)
    for c in sorted_calls:
        s, e = c['start'], c['end']
        overlap = False
        for (ps, pe) in intervals:
            if not (e <= ps or s >= pe):
                overlap = True
                break
        if not overlap:
            selected.append(c)
            intervals.append((s, e))
    # Order selected by start
    selected.sort(key=lambda c: c['start'])
    selected_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]
    # Apply replacements right-to-left
    for c in reversed(selected):
        s, e = c['start'], c['end']
        repl = c['replacement_tokens']
        tokens[s:e] = repl
    return {'selected_call_ids': selected_ids, 'tokens': tokens}"
}
